notes.title: Save Chantico! Demo 2.0
notes.content:
Greetings fellow explorers!

We are happy to present you with the Untraveled Lands: Chantico Demo 2.0. Update the game to the latest version to experience all the new changes.

The demo is now available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), German, Japanese, French, Polish, and Korean.

Since the release, we have showcased the demo at events, received a few award nominations, and gathered feedback from players. The highly requested save feature has finally been added to the demo:
[list]
[*]From now on, you can play the game and save your progress without worrying about starting over.
[*]Crafting items with blueprints from the journal is now optional, not mandatory. If you know the recipe, just stack the cards together and craft whatever you like.
[*]Blueprints have been updated too. Now you get a notification when the blueprint is ready, and you only need to add a survivor to craft the final result.
[*]You can grow plants by simply combining soil and plants. No survivor is required in this process anymore.
[*]Some of you requested more speed options for the game. Now we have normal, x2, and x3 speed settings. A small hint: you can switch game speed by pressing 1, 2, 3, and spacebar for pausing the game on your keyboard.
[*]We are adding more music and sounds by our composer and audio designer.
[*]Some minor changes to improve the game flow.
[/list]

As usual, we have resolved some bugs and issues to make the game play more smoothly. We are in a constant search for more, so if you find any, don't hesitate to share them with us.

Our friends in Shanghai can find Untraveled Lands: Chantico at BiliBili World from July 12, 2024, until July 14, 2024. Our booth number is 2G2-9, 2G2-10. We are excited to meet you there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930864/430bd7312c2f622878787cad862df43685a6def2.jpg[/img]

We're committed to collecting your suggestions and feedback to keep improving the demo and provide a better gaming experience! Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/pAwf8xQsN7]discord channel[/url] or follow our [url=https://twitter.com/ULChantico]Twitter (X) account[/url] to stay updated on the game's progress or to chat and connect with other players!

Your support and feedback are precious to us!

notes.title: Demo Update & Simplified Chinese Now Supported!
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers!

Untraveled Lands: Chantico has updated the Demo to include a Simplified Chinese version! Update game to the latest version to experience it in Chinese. 

Besides Simplified Chinese, we are also working on localizations for Traditional Chinese, Russian, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), German, Japanese, French, Polish, and Korean. Stay tuned!

Since the Demo release, we've received lots of feedback and have made several updates and fixes:
[list]
[*]Resolved various bugs that were blocking the game, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.
[*]Added the Altar recipe to the journal to prevent it from being lost when removed from the playing field.
[*]Improved the management and consumption of food for a more balanced gameplay experience.
[*]Monkeys no longer consume food at the end of the day. Players now need to feed them bananas only to tame them.
[*]Adjusted exploration times for better pacing and challenge.
[*]Added a dedicated confirmation for videohints to prevent them from being closed accidentally or due to errors.
[/list]

We're committed to collecting your suggestions and feedback to keep improving the Demo and provide a better gaming experience! Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/pAwf8xQsN7]discord channel[/url] or follow our [url=https://twitter.com/ULChantico]Twitter (X) account[/url] to stay updated on the game's progress or to chat and connect with other players!

If you enjoy the Demo, please adding it to your wishlist. Your support means a lot to us during the development process!

notes.title: Announcing the Demo & Participation in Endless Replayability Fest
notes.content:
Hey adventurers!

We're excited to announce that Untraveled Lands: Chantico is officially participating in the Endless Replayability Fest, and we've released a demo for you to try out! 
In our latest demo, you can experience:

- A storyline from Professor Howard's perspective, uncovering what the professor experienced in the rainforest.
- A beginner's tutorial to get you started on your Untraveled Lands: Chantico journey.
- A vast, explorable map, featuring over twenty different locations cards, and special events.
- The demo includes more than a hundred cards! Download the demo now and dive in!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496590/_Untraveled_Lands/

Since we announced our store page and trailer, we've received some love and attention from you guys, which we're incredibly grateful for! (Check the trailer)
[previewyoutube=WTekVTmuklc;full][/previewyoutube]
So, we've decided to release our first demo during this event! As the game is still in development, the demo is continuously being polished and optimized, [b]so what you experience at this stage does not represent the final quality of the game[/b].

If you have any feedback while playing the demo, don't hesitate to join our [url=https://discord.gg/pAwf8xQsN7]Discord channel[/url] and let us know! We hope you'll help us make the game even better!

————————————————————————————————————————————————————
If you enjoy our demo and trailer, and are looking forward to future content of the game, please add chantico to your wishlist!
Follow our [url=https://twitter.com/ULChantico]Twitter (X) account[/url] for the latest updates and exciting snippets about the game!
